original_query: What are affiliations of the person who says resilient behaviors are active behavior intended to retain the system identity?

confirmed.answer_text: The person presenting the concept is Vincenzo De Florio.; The affiliation of Vincenzo De Florio is INRIA.
confirmed.summary: The slide defines resilient behaviors as active behavior intended to retain system identity and references Aristotelian Entelechy with the phrase 'Being at work while staying the same.' It is attributed to Vincenzo De Florio from INRIA, dated November 14, 2014.
